employees.evidence: Berkshire has about 377,000 employees, only 26 of these are at headquarters.

shareholders.evidence: Charlie and I think of our shareholders as owner-partners, and of ourselves as managing partners.

integrity.evidence: We will be candid in our reporting to you, emphasizing the pluses and minuses important in appraising business value.

result.analyst_notes: Aspirational and first-person, with Buffett and Munger speaking as 'Charlie and I'. Shareholders are addressed first and most often, framed as owner-partners. Commitments are often hedged or conditional (we will try, we hope). Distinctive wording includes 'We eat our own cooking' and 'We do not measure ... by its size; we measure by per-share progress.' Largely factual, with explanatory essays on principles.
